About Us

Your trusted partner in long-term van & car hire

With over 10 years of experience, LTVCR specialises in dependable Hyundai vans, people movers and cars for both short-term and long-term rentals. Whether you are planning a business delivery, moving house or taking a family trip, our modern fleet means comfort, space and peace of mind on every journey.

  • Easy booking process

  • Convenient pick-up & return

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about long-term hire

01 What is the minimum hire period for a long-term rental in Melbourne?

There is no long lock-in contract. We hire daily, weekly and long-term, with flexible terms from under 2 weeks right through to 6 months or more. Tell us how long you need the vehicle and we will match a rate to it.

02 How much does long-term van and car hire cost?

Commercial vans such as the Hyundai iLoad and the 8-seater iMax people mover start from $100 per day, with discounted weekly and long-term rates the longer you hire. Car rates for the iX35, i30 and i40 depend on hire length, so call 0435 800 248 for a long-term quote.

03 Where do I pick up and drop off the vehicle?

We serve drivers right across Melbourne, metro-wide. Pick-up and return is from our convenient Hallam pick-up point at 3 David Lee Rd, Hallam VIC 3803.

04 What vehicles are available for long-term hire?

Our fleet is well-maintained Hyundai vehicles: the iLoad commercial van, the iMax 8-seater people mover, the iX35 SUV, and the i30 and i40 for economical everyday driving.

05 Can I hire a van or car for my business or trade?

Yes. The Hyundai iLoad is set up for tools, equipment, deliveries and business use, and long-term hire keeps your running costs predictable without tying up capital in a vehicle purchase or a rigid lease.

06 Do you offer short-term and daily hire as well as long-term?

Yes, we offer daily, short-term and long-term van and car hire. Long-term hire simply unlocks better weekly and monthly rates.
